trial_court: Family Court, Cuttack - Civil Proceeding No.600 of 2023
case_name: Suvralin Dash vs Rakesh Kumar Pati
facts_of_case: The husband filed a petition under Section 13(1) of the Hindu Marriage Act, 1955 for dissolution of his marriage with the wife. The trial court allowed the petition and fixed permanent alimony of Rs.2,00,000/- to the wife. The wife appealed against the judgment.

legal_principles.principle: The burden lies on the party seeking dissolution of marriage to prove that the marriage has broken down irretrievably.
legal_principles.held: After hearing the parties and considering the materials adduced before it by them, the learned Judge, Family Court, Cuttack allowed the said Civil Proceeding No.600 of 2023 of the respondent/petitioner-husband on contest against the appellant-wife.

legal_principles.principle: The court may grant alimony to the spouse who is unable to maintain themselves.
legal_principles.held: The learned Judge, Family Court, Cuttack by the impugned judgment dated 07.05.2026 allowed the said Civil Proceeding No.600 of 2023 of the respondent/petitioner-husband on contest against the appellant-wife fixing the permanent alimony of Rs.2,00,000/- (rupees two lakhs) to the appellant-wife.

outcome.final_order: The operation of the impugned Judgment dated 07.05.2026 passed by the learned Judge, Family Court, Cuttack in Civil Proceeding No.600/2023 shall remain stayed till the next date.
